originalTitle: Couple describes relief at rescue after whale destroys their yacht
summary: Jeremy and Jemma Cooper were 500 miles off the coast of New Zealand when their yacht, the Tai Tam, collided with a sperm whale.
content:
A couple have spoken of their relief to be rescued after a sperm whale collided with their yacht.

Jeremy and Jemma Cooper told the BBC that they were 500 nautical miles off the coast of New Zealand when the boat, the Tai Tam, lurched port side and they knew they'd "been hit by something" - only to see a pod of six sperm whales swimming behind the boat.

As their boat took on water and eventually sank, the Coopers and two other sailors aboard the vessel evacuated to a life raft. Seventeen hours later they were rescued by a container ship.

The couple told the BBC that, despite their ordeal, they would be out on the water again soon.

Video produced by Lana Lam, edited by Alex Foster.
chineseTitle: 夫妇描述鲸鱼毁坏他们的游艇后救援中的解脱
chineseSummary: 杰里米·库珀 (Jeremy Cooper) 和杰玛·库珀 (Jemma Cooper) 在距离新西兰海岸 500 英里的地方，他们的游艇“大潭”号 (Tai Tam) 与一头抹香鲸相撞。
chineseContent:
一对夫妇表示，在抹香鲸与他们的游艇相撞后获救，他们感到很欣慰。

杰里米·库珀和杰玛·库珀告诉英国广播公司，当大潭号船在左舷侧倾斜时，他们距离新西兰海岸 500 海里，他们知道自己“被什么东西击中了”，结果看到一群六只抹香鲸在船后面游动。

当他们的船进水并最终沉没时，库珀夫妇和船上的另外两名水手疏散到救生筏上。十七小时后，他们被一艘集装箱船救起。

这对夫妇告诉英国广播公司，尽管经历了磨难，他们很快就会再次出海。

视频由 Lana Lam 制作，由 Alex Foster 编辑。
